children: Keyless Accounts, Confidential APT, and Encrypted Mempool go live on Aptos mainnet on 13 October 2026. The three confidentiality layers are opt-in capabilities covering identity, amounts, and transaction intent. Users can access Confidential APT through Petra Wallet and Confidential Assets Web, giving the native token a confidentiality option within those interfaces.

Encrypted native-token transfers expand APT's privacy utility, with wallet access providing a way to use the capability. The bundled release also supports its appeal for institutional use where confidentiality is relevant. Availability, however, does not establish adoption: the announcement provides no evidence of actual usage or its impact.
Three layers of confidentiality. All live on Aptos mainnet.
Each one is opt-in, and each one addresses a different part of what's visible onchain.

title: Aptos: Keyless Accounts, Confidential APT and Encrypted Mempool go live - 13 Oct 2026
